enstatite.radius: the MIE section (the laser sizer's Mie inversion, r_eff 3.71 µm and v_eff 3.14, Frattin et al.'s Tables 3 and 4), its r the volume-equivalent radius (their §4.3.2), cut at 290 µm; the FRAUNHOFER section is not used (science-r08-nonspherical.md §7)
